en.title: Â
en.summary: The letter Â is a character in the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter name and sound
paragraphs: The name of this letter is the sound /ɨ/. It makes the vowel sound /ɨ/, as in the word (român) /roˈmɨn/, which means Romanian. This letter has only one sound in all words.

sections.title: Pronouncing this sound
paragraphs: Keep your lips relaxed and flat. Pull the middle of your tongue up toward the roof of your mouth. Do not push your tongue forward or pull it too far back. Let your vocal cords vibrate. Place two fingers on your throat to feel the steady vibration as you make this sound.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: You see this letter only inside words, never at the beginning or at the very end. It always represents the single sound /ɨ/, as in the word (cânt) /kɨnt/.

sections.title: Avoiding common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not replace this vowel with the short vowel in the English word sit. Do not round your lips as you would for the vowel in soon. Keep your lips flat, pull your tongue slightly back, and make the sound deep inside your mouth.
